Subject: GCP Listing Billing Orchestration & DocuSign Pathway

Hi Mike —

Following up from our technical onboarding last week: we want to align the procurement and billing path for the GCP Marketplace listing so your finance team has a clear invoice and signature flow. Attached is a draft SOW and a simple invoice template we typically use for marketplace purchases.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm which procurement mailbox will receive the DocuSign (procurement@acmehealth.com ok)?
- Do you need Redwood to issue invoices monthly or upon invoiceable milestones?
- Any internal PO or vendor form we should attach to the DocuSign packet?

I’ve cc’d Karthik and Lauren to map the SKU-to-invoice item mapping and Logan to confirm the billing cadence (monthly vs net-30 milestone).

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Acme_v1.pdf (pdf), acme_invoice_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:04:12 -0400
Subject: Re: GCP Listing Billing Orchestration & DocuSign Pathway

Marissa —

Thanks for sending. procurement@acmehealth.com is correct for DocuSign. Our procurement team prefers: PO-based billing (we generate a PO per quarter) and net-30 terms once the PO is issued.

Two things from our side:
1) We need Redwood to sign our vendor form (attached to this reply) or let us know if the DocuSign packet can include it.
2) Can you confirm the invoice line items will show the GCP Marketplace SKU and Redwood unit price (we need the SKU on the invoice to reconcile)?

I’ll loop in procurement directly if you want a specific contact — for now they monitor procurement@acmehealth.com.

Best,
Mike Jackson
Head of Procurement, Acme Health
mike.jackson@acmehealth.com
(212) 555-0199

Forwarding Acme's vendor form into the DocuSign packet. Lauren / Karthik / Logan — can you take the following actions so we can push to DocuSign by EOD tomorrow?

1) Karthik: please attach the SKU mapping CSV to the SOW and confirm the invoice line labels match the mapping (we want: Marketplace SKU | Description | Unit price | Qty).
2) Lauren: confirm legal's normalized signature block & confirm whether any of the SOW terms need to be redlined before DocuSign.
3) Logan: pick a billing cadence. Mike prefers PO-per-quarter + net-30; please confirm if Redwood invoices monthly with an aggregated SKU breakdown (our preference for predictability) or issues quarterly invoices to match their PO.

I’ve uploaded the packet here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_SOW-Acme and created the DocuSign powerform: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-docusign

Attachments included in packet: Redwood_SOW_Acme_v1.pdf, acme_invoice_template.xlsx, Acme_Vendor_Form.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa

Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 08:35:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP Listing Billing Orchestration & DocuSign Pathway

Marissa —

I pulled the initial SKU mapping draft and attached a minimal csv: sku_mapping_draft.csv. Notes:
- We will surface the marketplace SKU on the invoice as "GCP SKU" in the first column and include Redwood's unit price next to it.
- For reconciliation with Acme's PO, recommend we issue monthly invoices that include an "Aggregated Quarterly PO" line so they can match to the quarter PO number. That keeps our cashflow predictable and aligns with their PO cadence.
- On revenue recognition: quarterly PO doesn't change our delivery milestones — we invoice monthly for usage/seat-based SKUs and mark the invoice with the PO number as provided.

I flagged one SOW clause to review (section 4.2 - payment timing) — Lauren, optional for Legal if they want to tighten wording.

Attachments: sku_mapping_draft.csv

-karthik

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mike Jackson <mike.jackson@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP Listing Billing Orchestration & DocuSign Pathway

All —

Thanks for the inputs. Quick summary and next steps:
- Billing cadence: Redwood will invoice monthly with an "Aggregated Quarterly PO" field; Logan will set the invoice template to include both the itemized SKU rows and an aggregated PO summary. (Logan: please update acme_invoice_template.xlsx to include the PO summary row.)
- DocuSign packet: include Acme_Vendor_Form.pdf and Redwood_SOW_Acme_v1.pdf. Marissa will initiate DocuSign powerform to procurement@acmehealth.com once the SOW clause is confirmed.
- Legal redline: minor tweak to section 4.2 accepted — no substantive change. Lauren confirmed signature block.
- Action owners: Marissa (initiate DocuSign & send final packet), Karthik (finalize SKU mapping csv), Logan (update invoice template + confirm monthly invoice schedule).

Marissa — can you please kick the DocuSign now and copy this thread into the envelope so procurement receives the full packet? I'd like this routed and signed by end of day Friday to hit July billing cycle.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
